identity.precise_name: per-task sequential least-busy feasible RSU placement
identity.deterministic_basis: recompute argmin(effective_busy_ms) for every admitted candidate with lowest-index tie-break; no RNG draw or key split
identity.actor_selects_rsu_explanation: Frozen MAPPO actor emits Local/V2I/V2V intent only; infrastructure deterministic placement selects execution RSU downstream. Conflating actor intent with placement selection is forbidden.

scope_bound.bounded_to: E2d per-task placement robustness evidence only
scope_bound.not_broadened_beyond: No claim beyond E2d four matched fleet draws (seeds 1-4) over Manchester incident hour; no universal least-busy or general controller superiority
scope_bound.source_honesty: RESEARCH-EVIDENCE FACT bounded by E2d manifest f77afb231f7d0be2c13627e9fbdc6bf635ea86b351bf0a0e7c83295ef0435740

rsu_busy_ms.description: total remaining RSU compute workload in milliseconds of service work
rsu_busy_ms.semantics: admitted rsu_compute_ms added, at most 1000 ms drained per simulated second, remainder carried

rsu_load_count.description: admitted task count load on RSU (incremented by one per admitted task)

live_vectors.description: live rb/rl vectors at task-substep entry; temporary effective vectors start from these

candidate_context.description: candidate task type determines TASK_DEADLINE_MS[task_type] threshold; candidate padded vehicle-slot index determines order

order.candidate_order: ascending task-substep index, then ascending padded vehicle-slot index
order.task_substeps_per_step: multiple Model-C task substeps per simulated second (exact count from vec_jax task decomposition)
order.source_honesty: IMPLEMENTATION-VERIFIED FACT and RESEARCH-EVIDENCE FACT via E2d manifest selector_contract.candidate_order

feasible_set.post_selection_eligibility: positive ingress-link quality and selected target below cap at substep entry checked after selection, before admission

load_and_service_work_quantity.state_interpretation: shortest remaining service workload in rsu_busy_ms
load_and_service_work_quantity.state_units: milliseconds of RSU compute service work
load_and_service_work_quantity.selection_metric: argmin(effective_busy_ms) across all RSUs, recomputed for every candidate

service_reservation.quantity: exact selected RSU service work for the admitted task
service_reservation.derivation: split index 1 from existing five-way process_agent subkey split, evaluated by compute_time_ms(..., RSU_TIER_IDX) divided by selected target service multiplier
service_reservation.rng_change: no new random draw, split or changed key chain

immediate_reservation_update.admitted_update: add one load unit and exact selected RSU service work to temporary effective vectors immediately after admission; affects next candidate in scan order
immediate_reservation_update.rejected_update: unavailable, gate-rejected and cap-rejected work changes no temporary state
immediate_reservation_update.visibility: per-task sequential; each candidate sees all prior admitted reservations in the same substep

deterministic_tie_break.rule: jnp.argmin lowest RSU index on exact workload tie

steps_in_order: a. record selected target for V2I attempt
b. inherited ingress-radio eligibility (positive ingress-link quality)
c. strict backlog deadline gate at selected target
d. live in-batch cap with gate-before-cap outcome precedence
e. only if admitted commit via unchanged evaluator scatter

deadline_gate.deadline_aware_means: backlog-only simulator rule, not confirmed physical result return
deadline_gate.source_honesty: IMPLEMENTATION-VERIFIED FACT; removing it is forbidden (mutant: removed-gate)

cap.overflow_semantics: immediate terminal rejection without queue entry, retry, fallback or re-forwarding
cap.queue_semantics: RSU queue capacity is admission/waiting-room ceiling, not computation power
cap.source_honesty: SOURCE-DERIVED FACT via S-007 and S-035; IMPLEMENTATION-VERIFIED FACT via sequential/reject

reconciliation.description: repeat complete causal pass three times from identical live rb/rl state and use idempotent final result; state never accumulates across passes

forwarding.definition: true exactly when admitted V2I execution RSU differs from strongest-link ingress RSU

refusal_taxonomy.unavailable: no positive ingress link or no V2I candidate at slot
refusal_taxonomy.gate_rejected: deadline gate fails at selected target
refusal_taxonomy.cap_rejected: live cap rejects at selected target

actor_boundary.actor_emits_only_intent: V2I offload intent via best available link reasoning; infrastructure decides execution RSU
actor_boundary.source_honesty: SOURCE-DERIVED FACT via S-035 plus RESEARCH-EVIDENCE FACT via E2d manifest inputs.actor; misattribution is mutant actor-RSU-credit
